correctness.rationale: The common-divisor resultant is an identity; every root of the specialized gcd must lie in one of λ3−d,λ3,λ3+d. Continuity on a pole-free arc and discreteness give a rational root a for both Q(t,z) and Q(t+d,z). Monicity yields a Laurent polynomial and extremal exponents force order one. Since a and a+d are eigenvalues on the full unit circle, any departure from ordered λ3 would put a root strictly between λ3 and λ2, so a=λ3 globally. Antipodal symmetry and Li–Sze give the disk; exact monic division yields circular Kippenhahn factor. Multiplicities and degeneracies are explicitly accounted for.

originality.rationale: The 2026 extreme-gap result does not include a middle-gap rank-two rigidity theorem. The 2021 higher-rank study states the raw-versus-actual-width distinction and constructs a constant-gap noncircular six-dimensional example but does not give the universal four-dimensional positive-middle-gap theorem. In 4x4, possible common-divisor roots form one three-offset ladder; this yields a rational lower-middle eigenvalue and a globally fixed branch. The resulting universal disk and circular factor were not implied by the inspected closest source statements or indexed specialized comparisons. Older algebraic-pencil descriptions may remain a bibliographic risk.
residual_risks: A differently expressed unpublished or older algebraic-pencil classification could potentially imply this 4x4 middle-gap result, despite lack of an identified match.
Indexed research summaries are not a substitute for all historical full texts; summary-level comparisons do not prove complete absence.
The 2021 example shows arbitrary-dimensional extension is false; no assertion beyond matrix size four is made.

value.rationale: Four dimensions are the minimal universally nonempty rank-two numerical-range case. The new statement obtains full middle spectral eigenvalue profiles, a rank-two disk and a circular characteristic factor from a direction-independent interior gap. The 2021 six-dimensional gap-versus-width example makes the dimension boundary mathematically motivated and sharp against unrestricted extrapolation; this is not a routine special numerical computation.
